units.left_text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:
units.right_text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

units.left_text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
units.right_text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

units.left_text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,
units.right_text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort,

units.left_text: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
units.right_text: who comforts us in all our troubles, so that we can comfort those in any trouble with the comfort we ourselves have received from God.

units.left_text: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.
units.right_text: For just as the sufferings of Christ overflow to us, so also through Christ our comfort overflows.

units.left_text: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.
units.right_text: If we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation; if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which accomplishes in you patient endurance of the same sufferings we experience.

units.left_text: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.
units.right_text: And our hope for you is sure, because we know that just as you share in our sufferings, so also you will share in our comfort.

units.left_text: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.
units.right_text: We do not want you to be unaware, brothers, of the hardships we encountered in the province of Asia. We were under a burden far beyond our ability to endure, so that we despaired even of life.

units.left_text: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,
units.right_text: Indeed, we felt we were under the sentence of death, in order that we would not trust in ourselves, but in God, who raises the dead.

units.left_text: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,

units.left_text: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

units.left_text: For we write no other things to you than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end—

units.left_text: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”

units.left_text: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me, Silvanus, and Timothy—was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”

units.left_text: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.

units.left_text: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.

units.right_text: Make room for us in your hearts. We have wronged no one, we have corrupted no one, we have exploited no one.

units.left_text: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.
units.right_text: I do not say this to condemn you. I have said before that you so occupy our hearts that we live and die together with you.

units.left_text: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.
units.right_text: Great is my confidence in you; great is my pride in you; I am filled with encouragement; in all our troubles my joy overflows.

units.left_text: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.
units.right_text: For when we arrived in Macedonia, our bodies had no rest, but we were pressed from every direction — conflicts on the outside, fears within.

units.left_text: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,
units.right_text: But God, who comforts the downcast, comforted us by the arrival of Titus,

units.left_text: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced still more.
units.right_text: and not only by his arrival, but also by the comfort he had received from you. He told us about your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced all the more.

units.left_text: For though I grieved you with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you grieve, though just for a while.
units.right_text: Even if I caused you sorrow by my letter, I do not regret it. Although I did regret it— for I see that my letter caused you sorrow, but only for a short time—

units.left_text: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.
units.right_text: yet now I rejoice, not because you were made sorrowful, but because your sorrow led you to repentance. For you felt the sorrow that God had intended, and so were not harmed in any way by us.

units.left_text: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.
units.right_text: Godly sorrow brings repentance that leads to salvation without regret, but worldly sorrow brings death.

units.left_text: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.
units.right_text: Consider what this godly sorrow has produced in you: what earnestness, what eagerness to clear yourselves, what indignation, what alarm, what longing, what zeal, what vindication! In every way you have proved yourselves to be innocent in this matter.

units.left_text: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.
units.right_text: So even though I wrote to you, it was not on account of the one who did wrong or the one who was harmed, but rather that your earnestness on our behalf would be made clear to you in the sight of God.

units.left_text: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.
units.right_text: On account of this, we are encouraged.

units.left_text: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.
units.right_text: Indeed, I was not embarrassed by anything I had boasted to him about you. But just as everything we said to you was true, so our boasting to Titus has proved to be true as well.

units.left_text: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.
units.right_text: And his affection for you is even greater when he remembers that you were all obedient as you welcomed him with fear and trembling.

units.left_text: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.
units.right_text: I rejoice that I can have complete confidence in you.

units.left_text: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,
units.right_text: Now, brothers, we want you to know about the grace that God has given the churches of Macedonia.

units.left_text: how in a severe ordeal of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity.
units.right_text: In the terrible ordeal they suffered, their abundant joy and deep poverty overflowed into rich generosity.

units.left_text: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,
units.right_text: For I testify that they gave according to their ability and even beyond it. Of their own accord,

units.left_text: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.
units.right_text: they earnestly pleaded with us for the privilege of sharing in this service to the saints.

units.left_text: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.
units.right_text: And not only did they do as we expected, but they gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, through the will of God.

units.left_text: So we urged Titus, that as he had made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.
units.right_text: So we urged Titus to help complete your act of grace, just as he had started it.

units.left_text: But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.
units.right_text: But just as you excel in everything — in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in complete earnestness, and in the love we inspired in you — see that you also excel in this grace of giving.

units.left_text: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.
units.right_text: I am not giving a command, but I am testing the sincerity of your love through the earnestness of others.

units.left_text: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.
units.right_text: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though He was rich, yet for your sake He became poor, so that you through His poverty might become rich.

units.left_text: I give advice in this: it is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.
units.right_text: And this is my opinion about what is helpful for you in this matter: Last year you were the first not only to give, but even to have such a desire.

units.left_text: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.
units.right_text: Now finish the work, so that you may complete it with the same eager desire, according to your means.

units.left_text: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.
units.right_text: For if the eagerness is there, the gift is acceptable according to what one has, not according to what he does not have.

units.left_text: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,
units.right_text: It is not our intention that others may be relieved while you are burdened, but that there may be equality.

units.left_text: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack, that there may be equality.
units.right_text: At the present time, your surplus will meet their need, so that in turn their surplus will meet your need. This way there will be equality.

units.left_text: As it is written, “He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.”
units.right_text: As it is written:

units.left_text: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.
units.right_text: But thanks be to God, who put into the heart of Titus the same devotion I have for you.

units.left_text: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.
units.right_text: For not only did he welcome our appeal, but he is eagerly coming to you of his own volition.

units.left_text: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies.
units.right_text: Along with Titus we are sending the brother who is praised by all the churches for his work in the gospel.

units.left_text: Not only so, but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.
units.right_text: More than that, this brother was chosen by the churches to accompany us with the gracious offering we administer to honor the Lord Himself and to show our eagerness to help.

units.left_text: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.
units.right_text: We want to avoid any criticism of the way we administer this generous gift.

units.left_text: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
units.right_text: For we are taking great care to do what is right, not only in the eyes of the Lord, but also in the eyes of men.

units.left_text: We have sent with them our brother whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.
units.right_text: And we are sending along with them our brother who has proven his earnestness to us many times and in many ways, and now even more so by his great confidence in you.

units.left_text: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.
units.right_text: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker among you. As for our brothers, they are messengers of the churches, the glory of Christ.

units.left_text: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.
units.right_text: In full view of the churches, then, show these men the proof of your love and the reason for our boasting about you.

units.left_text: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,
units.right_text: Now about the service to the saints, there is no need for me to write to you.

units.left_text: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the past year. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.
units.right_text: For I know your eagerness to help, and I have been boasting to the Macedonians that since last year you in Achaia were prepared to give. And your zeal has stirred most of them to do likewise.

units.left_text: But I have sent the brothers so that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,
units.right_text: But I am sending the brothers in order that our boasting about you in this matter should not prove empty, but that you will be prepared, just as I said.

units.left_text: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) would be disappointed in this confident boasting.
units.right_text: Otherwise, if any Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we — to say nothing of you — would be ashamed of having been so confident.

units.left_text: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.
units.right_text: So I thought it necessary to urge the brothers to visit you beforehand and make arrangements for the generous gift you had promised. This way, your gift will be prepared generously and not begrudgingly.

units.left_text: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.
units.right_text: Remember this: Whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and whoever sows generously will also reap generously.

units.left_text: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
units.right_text: Each one should give what he has decided in his heart to give, not out of regret or compulsion. For God loves a cheerful giver.

units.left_text: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.
units.right_text: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, so that in all things, at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.

units.left_text: As it is written,
units.right_text: As it is written:

units.left_text: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness,
units.right_text: Now He who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your store of seed and will increase the harvest of your righteousness.

units.left_text: you being enriched in everything for all generosity, which produces thanksgiving to God through us.
units.right_text: You will be enriched in every way to be generous on every occasion, and through us your generosity will produce thanksgiving to God.

units.left_text: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God,
units.right_text: For this ministry of service is not only supplying the needs of the saints but is also overflowing in many expressions of thanksgiving to God.

units.left_text: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all,
units.right_text: Because of the proof this ministry provides, the saints will glorify God for your obedient confession of the gospel of Christ, and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all the others.

units.left_text: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.
units.right_text: And their prayers for you will express their affection for you, because of the surpassing grace God has given you.

units.left_text: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!
units.right_text: Thanks be to God for His indescribable gift!

units.left_text: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.
units.right_text: Now by the mildness and gentleness of Christ, I appeal to you — I, Paul, who am humble when face to face with you, but bold when away.

units.left_text: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.
units.right_text: I beg you that when I come I may not need to be as bold as I expect toward those who presume that we live according to the flesh.

units.left_text: For though we walk in the flesh, we don’t wage war according to the flesh;
units.right_text: For though we live in the flesh, we do not wage war according to the flesh.

units.left_text: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,
units.right_text: The weapons of our warfare are not the weapons of the flesh. Instead, they have divine power to demolish strongholds.

units.left_text: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,
units.right_text: We demolish arguments and every presumption set up against the knowledge of God; and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.

units.left_text: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.
units.right_text: And we will be ready to punish every act of disobedience, as soon as your obedience is complete.

units.left_text: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ’s, let him consider this again with himself, that even as he is Christ’s, so we also are Christ’s.
units.right_text: You are looking at outward appearances. If anyone is confident that he belongs to Christ, he should remind himself that we belong to Christ just as much as he does.

units.left_text: For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for casting you down, I will not be ashamed,
units.right_text: For even if I boast somewhat excessively about the authority the Lord gave us for building you up rather than tearing you down, I will not be ashamed.

units.left_text: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.
units.right_text: I do not want to seem to be trying to frighten you by my letters.

units.left_text: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”
units.right_text: For some say, “His letters are weighty and forceful, but his physical presence is unimpressive, and his speaking is of no account.”

units.left_text: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.
units.right_text: Such people should consider that what we are in our letters when absent, we will be in our actions when present.

units.left_text: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.
units.right_text: We do not dare to classify or compare ourselves with some who commend themselves. When they measure themselves by themselves and compare themselves with themselves, they show their ignorance.

units.left_text: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.
units.right_text: We, however, will not boast beyond our limits, but only within the field of influence that God has assigned to us — a field that reaches even to you.

units.left_text: For we don’t stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn’t reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,
units.right_text: We are not overstepping our bounds, as if we had not come to you. Indeed, we were the first to reach you with the gospel of Christ.

units.left_text: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men’s labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,
units.right_text: Neither do we boast beyond our limits in the labors of others. But we hope that as your faith increases, our area of influence among you will greatly increase as well,

units.left_text: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.
units.right_text: so that we can preach the gospel in the regions beyond you. Then we will not be boasting in the work already done in another man’s territory.

units.left_text: But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
units.right_text: Rather, “Let him who boasts boast in the Lord.”

units.left_text: For it isn’t he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.
units.right_text: For it is not the one who commends himself who is approved, but the one whom the Lord commends.

units.left_text: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.
units.right_text: I hope you will put up with a little of my foolishness, but you are already doing that.

units.left_text: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you in marriage to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.
units.right_text: I am jealous for you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you to one husband, to present you as a pure virgin to Christ.

units.left_text: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
units.right_text: I am afraid, however, that just as Eve was deceived by the serpent’s cunning, your minds may be led astray from your simple and pure devotion to Christ.

units.left_text: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit which you didn’t receive, or a different “good news” which you didn’t accept, you put up with that well enough.
units.right_text: For if someone comes and proclaims a Jesus other than the One we proclaimed, or if you receive a different spirit than the One you received, or a different gospel than the one you accepted, you put up with it very easily.

units.left_text: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.
units.right_text: I consider myself in no way inferior to those “super-apostles.”

units.left_text: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.
units.right_text: Although I am not a polished speaker, I am certainly not lacking in knowledge. We have made this clear to you in every way possible.

units.left_text: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge?
units.right_text: Was it a sin for me to humble myself in order to exalt you, because I preached the gospel of God to you free of charge?

units.left_text: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.
units.right_text: I robbed other churches by accepting their support in order to serve you.

units.left_text: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn’t a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.
units.right_text: And when I was with you and in need, I was not a burden to anyone; for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied my needs. I have refrained from being a burden to you in any way, and I will continue to do so.

units.left_text: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
units.right_text: As surely as the truth of Christ is in me, this boasting of mine will not be silenced in the regions of Achaia.

units.left_text: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.
units.right_text: Why? Because I do not love you? God knows I do!

units.left_text: But what I do, that I will continue to do, that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity, that in which they boast, they may be recognized just like us.
units.right_text: But I will keep on doing what I am doing, in order to undercut those who want an opportunity to be regarded as our equals in the things of which they boast.

units.left_text: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.
units.right_text: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as apostles of Christ.

units.left_text: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.
units.right_text: And no wonder, for Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light.

units.left_text: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.
units.right_text: It is not surprising, then, if his servants masquerade as servants of righteousness. Their end will correspond to their actions.

units.left_text: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.
units.right_text: I repeat: Let no one take me for a fool. But if you do, then receive me as a fool, so that I too may boast a little.

units.left_text: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.
units.right_text: In this confident boasting of mine, I am not speaking as the Lord would, but as a fool.

units.left_text: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.
units.right_text: Since many are boasting according to the flesh, I too will boast.

units.left_text: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.
units.right_text: For you gladly put up with fools, since you are so wise.

units.left_text: For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, or if he strikes you on the face.
units.right_text: In fact, you even put up with anyone who enslaves you or exploits you or takes advantage of you or exalts himself or strikes you in the face.

units.left_text: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.
units.right_text: To my shame I concede that we were too weak for that!

units.left_text: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.
units.right_text: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they descendants of Abraham? So am I.

units.left_text: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.
units.right_text: Are they servants of Christ? (I am speaking as if I were out of my mind.) I am so much more: in harder labor, in more imprisonments, in worse beatings, in frequent danger of death.

units.left_text: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.
units.right_text: Five times I received from the Jews the forty lashes minus one.

units.left_text: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.
units.right_text: Three times I was beaten with rods, once I was stoned, three times I was shipwrecked. I spent a night and a day in the open sea.

units.left_text: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;
units.right_text: In my frequent journeys, I have been in danger from rivers and from bandits, in danger from my countrymen and from the Gentiles, in danger in the city and in the country, in danger on the sea and among false brothers,

units.left_text: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.
units.right_text: in labor and toil and often without sleep, in hunger and thirst and often without food, in cold and exposure.

units.left_text: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.
units.right_text: Apart from these external trials, I face daily the pressure of my concern for all the churches.

units.left_text: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?
units.right_text: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is led into sin, and I do not burn with grief?

units.left_text: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.
units.right_text: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that show my weakness.

units.left_text: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.
units.right_text: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, who is forever worthy of praise, knows that I am not lying.

units.left_text: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.
units.right_text: In Damascus, the governor under King Aretas secured the city of the Damascenes in order to arrest me.

units.left_text: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.
units.right_text: But I was lowered in a basket through a window in the wall and escaped his grasp.

units.left_text: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
units.right_text: I must go on boasting. Although there is nothing to gain, I will go on to visions and revelations from the Lord.

units.left_text: I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven fourteen years ago—whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows.
units.right_text: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the third heaven. Whether it was in the body or out of it I do not know, but God knows.

units.left_text: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),
units.right_text: And I know that this man— whether in the body or out of it I do not know, but God knows—

units.left_text: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
units.right_text: was caught up to Paradise. The things he heard were inexpressible, things that man is not permitted to tell.

units.left_text: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.
units.right_text: I will boast about such a man, but I will not boast about myself, except in my weaknesses.

units.left_text: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me or hears from me.
units.right_text: Even if I wanted to boast, I would not be a fool, because I would be speaking the truth. But I refrain, so no one will credit me with more than he sees in me or hears from me,

units.left_text: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.
units.right_text: or because of these surpassingly great revelations.

units.left_text: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.
units.right_text: Three times I pleaded with the Lord to take it away from me.

units.left_text: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
units.right_text: But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.

units.left_text: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.
units.right_text: That is why, for the sake of Christ, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong.

units.left_text: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.
units.right_text: I have become a fool, but you drove me to it. In fact, you should have commended me, since I am in no way inferior to those “super-apostles,” even though I am nothing.

units.left_text: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.
units.right_text: The marks of a true apostle — signs, wonders, and miracles — were performed among you with great perseverance.

units.left_text: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!
units.right_text: In what way were you inferior to the other churches, except that I was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

units.left_text: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
units.right_text: See, I am ready to come to you a third time, and I will not be a burden, because I am not seeking your possessions, but you. For children should not have to save up for their parents, but parents for their children.

units.left_text: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
units.right_text: And for the sake of your souls, I will most gladly spend my money and myself. If I love you more, will you love me less?

units.left_text: Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. But you might say that being crafty, I caught you with deception.
units.right_text: Be that as it may, I was not a burden to you; but crafty as I am, I caught you by trickery.

units.left_text: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?
units.right_text: Did I exploit you by anyone I sent you?

units.left_text: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?
units.right_text: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent our brother with him. Did Titus exploit you in any way? Did we not walk in the same Spirit and follow in the same footsteps?

units.left_text: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.
units.right_text: Have you been thinking all along that we were making a defense to you? We speak before God in Christ, and all of this, beloved, is to build you up.

units.left_text: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire, that perhaps there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots,
units.right_text: For I am afraid that when I come, I may not find you as I wish, and you may not find me as you wish. I fear that there may be quarreling, jealousy, rage, rivalry, slander, gossip, arrogance, and disorder.

units.left_text: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and lustfulness which they committed.
units.right_text: I am afraid that when I come again, my God will humble me before you, and I will be grieved over many who have sinned earlier and have not repented of their acts of impurity, sexual immorality, and debauchery.

units.left_text: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”
units.right_text: This is the third time I am coming to you. “Every matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.”

units.left_text: I have warned previously, and I warn again, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now and to all the rest that if I come again, I will not spare,
units.right_text: I already warned you the second time I was with you. So now in my absence I warn those who sinned earlier and everyone else: If I return, I will not spare anyone,

units.left_text: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak, but is powerful in you.
units.right_text: since you are demanding proof that Christ is speaking through me. He is not weak in dealing with you but is powerful among you.

units.left_text: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.
units.right_text: For He was indeed crucified in weakness, yet He lives by God’s power. For we are also weak in Him, yet by God’s power we will live with Him concerning you.

units.left_text: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.
units.right_text: Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith; test yourselves. Do you not realize that Jesus Christ is in you — unless you fail the test?

units.left_text: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.
units.right_text: And I hope you will realize that we have not failed the test.

units.left_text: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.
units.right_text: Now we pray to God that you will not do anything wrong — not that we will appear to have stood the test, but that you will do what is right, even if we appear to have failed.

units.left_text: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
units.right_text: For we cannot do anything against the truth, but only for the truth.

units.left_text: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.
units.right_text: In fact, we rejoice when we are weak but you are strong, and our prayer is for your perfection.

units.left_text: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.
units.right_text: This is why I write these things while absent, so that when I am present I will not need to be severe in my use of the authority that the Lord gave me for building you up, not for tearing you down.

units.left_text: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.
units.right_text: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Aim for perfect harmony, encourage one another, be of one mind, live in peace. And the God of love and peace will be with you.

units.left_text: Greet one another with a holy kiss.
units.right_text: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

units.left_text: All the saints greet you.
units.right_text: All the saints send you greetings.

units.left_text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.
units.right_text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with all of you.
